criteria.requirement: Normalize expected data-conversion errors of builtin bool/int/float/timestamp constructors into ConstructorError/YAMLError with node.start_mark and original cause where an underlying conversion failed. Handle empty/sign-only/nonnumeric/bad timestamp syntax and impossible calendar values. Check missing timestamp regex match explicitly rather than leaking AttributeError. Preserve legal types and ordinary constructors; do not broadly catch arbitrary Exception, TypeError/AttributeError from unknown programming mistakes or user custom constructor errors.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
